segments.tts: Hockey's wildest moments, round two. Let's go!
Alex Ovechkin, 2006. Scores lying on his back!
Sliding, one hand, past Brian Boucher – with Wayne Gretzky coaching the other team.
On his back?! I can't even stand up.
Darryl Sittler, 1976. Ten points in one game!
Six goals, four assists. Still the NHL record.
Boston's goalie? I feel you, buddy.
2019: Andrei Svechnikov scoops the puck lacrosse-style. First ever in the NHL!
I got scooped like ice cream!
And 1995: Florida's Scott Mellanby smacks a rat in the locker room… then scores twice with that stick!
Rat trick! Back in my day, we only had hat tricks.
Back in your day, the rat was the goalie.
